verdict.2002_certificate: closure dominates with P=0.5466 (MSE 90% CI [0.319, 2.67] vs threshold 1.126)
verdict.2010_certificate_lost: P=0.7871 that the 2002 closure-dominance certificate is LOST under 2010 (MSE CI [0.179, 1.7273] below 1.126)
verdict.flip_sensitivity: the stronger 'inputs bind' reading (B_insuff > B_closure) holds for any true B_insuff > MSE_2010/2 = 0.3826; every B_insuff estimate we have exceeds it: {'LOTV': 0.563, 'RF': 0.565, 'ridge': 0.625, 'kNN_biased_up': 0.4} (only the kNN estimate, known biased-DOWN as a floor and biased for this, is near it). verdict.honest_claim: Under 2010/dsp the closure-dominance certificate is robustly lost; the binding term is no longer certifiably the closure. A certified flip to the inputs would need a lower bound on B_insuff, which we do not have.
